messages.content: Calculate the volume of the sphere with radius 3 units.

function.name: calculate_park_area
function.description: Calculate the total area of a park based on the radius of its circular part. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

radius.description: The radius of the circular part of the park. This is a float type value.

shape.description: The shape of the park. Default is 'circle'.

message.content:
The volume \(V\) of a sphere with radius \(r\) is given by  

\[
V=\frac{4}{3}\,\pi\,r^{3}.
\]

For \(r = 3 \text{ units}\):

1. Compute \(r^{3}=3^{3}=27.\)
2. Multiply by \(\pi:\;\pi\times27 = 27\pi.\)
3. Multiply by \(\tfrac{4}{3}:\)

\[
V = \frac{4}{3}\times 27\pi = 36\pi .
\]

So,

\[
\boxed{V = 36\pi \approx 113.10}
\]

in cubic units.
